text:
emma: Quick check — I'm going to rotate the k8s ServiceAccount we use for payments-processor (payments-prod) to a new IAM role via IRSA. Plan: update the Terraform payments-sa module to add the eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn annotation pointing to aws_iam_role.payments_processor. Anyone see infra gotchas? especially Secrets Store CSI and RBAC bindings. cc @alice @chris

alice: Sounds reasonable. If the ServiceAccount name stays the same, existing RoleBindings should be fine. Do we have any hardcoded ARNs in KMS key policy to update?

chris: If SA name unchanged, RBs are OK. But double-check Secrets Store / CSI provider usage — it relies on the SA for IAM access. Also confirm the IAM role's trust policy is correct for the service account sub/namespace.

sana: Also watch for any mutating webhook or admission that selects by serviceAccount labels/annotations. Some of our sidecar injectors look for labels, not annotations.

emma: SA name will remain payments-processor. Only annotation change. Terraform snippet I plan to apply in payments-sa module:

```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service_account" "payments_processor" {
  metadata {
    name = "payments-processor"
    namespace = "payments-prod"
    annotations = {
      "eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn" = aws_iam_role.payments_processor.arn
    }
  }
}
```

infra-bot: plan_check: terraform plan run in staging, no diff for RoleBindings. module: infra/payments-sa. Reference: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/eks/latest/userguide/iam-roles-for-service-accounts.html :white_check_mark:

rob: One more: double-check Cluster Autoscaler permissions and any PodDisruptionBudgets — rolling pods with new tokens should be safe but worth watching.

alice: I'll prepare the KMS key policy change. Prefer adding the exact role ARN once it's created, rather than a wide wildcard. We should run plan in staging that outputs the role ARN variable.

emma: Plan for rollout: 1) create IAM role (separate TF change) 2) apply SA annotation update 3) kubectl rollout restart deploy/payments-processor to pickup new tokens. I can do a canary in payments-prod-canary namespace first. Any objections?

chris: No objections. Canary is smart. Also add a short TTL for pod tokens? default should be fine but we can reduce if we want faster token rotation during test.

sana: +1 canary. I'll tail logs and watch auth failures and 5xx spikes.

emma: I'll open the PR and link it here when ready. Targeting today afternoon. Ping me for reviews. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: monitor_rule: set temporary alert for >3% 5xx from payments-processor over 15m during rollout window. I'll post alert link once created.

alice: (reaction :eyes:)
